# Dorado Project

> Dorado Project is a genre-fluid music project. Tracks are inspired by ideas, journeys, people and moments rather than one fixed genre.

Official website: https://doradoproject.com/

## Releases and stories

- [Dorado Project](https://doradoproject.com/): official homepage and release overview.
- **Brood met pindakaas**: upcoming Dutch funk-pop, disco and ska single with slap bass, brass, electric guitar and saxophone.
- [Neon Sax Drive](https://open.spotify.com/track/24uxBM9Q1QBSMO1K5md8fg): instrumental synthwave and jazz-rock single featuring synthesizers, electric guitar, saxophones and a virtuoso drum solo.
- [De top is nooit het eindpunt](https://open.spotify.com/track/5ocVnbCZkumVALinHFYfCD): Dutch pop-rock mountain anthem by Dorado Project.
- [CHAMONIX 2712](https://open.spotify.com/track/76GIGuqKAEbLPikUncWRsE): pop-rock track inspired by a mountain trip to Chamonix and the Mont Blanc landscape. [Story and photo journal](https://doradoproject.com/chamonix.html).
- [Midnight Overdrive](https://open.spotify.com/track/387TkwMvZBSsrUE1vJpvdb): electronic big beat and breakbeat single built for empty roads and flashing lights.
